name: [Part 1] global busy union
input: overlap across nodes and later gap

name: [Part 1] clip and merge adjacent intervals
input: unsorted, nested, adjacent, and outside-window tasks
test:
tasks = [(7,12,'c'),(-3,2,'a'),(2,5,'b'),(3,4,'a'),(20,21,'a')]
before = list(tasks)
assert idle_intervals(tasks,0,10) == [(5,7)]
assert tasks == before

name: [Part 1] empty and fully covered
input: empty fleet and busy whole query

name: [Part 2] stream updates bridge earlier intervals
input: out-of-order additions eventually merge busy range
test:
s = BusyTimeline()
assert s.get_idle(0,10) == [(0,10)]
s.add(5,7,'a')
s.add(1,3,'b')
assert s.get_idle(0,10) == [(0,1),(3,5),(7,10)]
s.add(3,5,'c')
assert s.get_idle(0,10) == [(0,1),(7,10)]
s.add(2,6,'d')
assert s.get_idle(2,6) == []
assert s.get_idle(7,9) == [(7,9)]

name: [Part 2] contained and repeated tasks
input: nested interval does not change fleet coverage
test:
s = BusyTimeline()
s.add(2,8,'a')
s.add(3,4,'b')
s.add(2,8,'c')
assert s.get_idle(0,10) == [(0,2),(8,10)]
assert s.get_idle(3,7) == []
